what_changed: PO-7781 (400 MC-500 motor controllers) will now arrive in two parts: 120 units on day 5 as scheduled, and the remaining 280 three weeks later on day 26.
decisions_for_a_person: Decide whether to take up Karen Walsh's offer to discuss other options this week, for example getting part of the remaining 280 units before day 14 so that O-1043 (City of Ashford Bike Share, which has a late penalty) ships on time.
Decide how to handle the late orders O-1043 (12 days late, with a penalty), O-1044 (8 days late) and O-1045 (5 days late), including whether to tell those customers.
supplier_questions: Which of your customers are most affected, so Northgate can understand the impact on your side?
